sentences: Millennials were told that if you did well in school, got a decent degree, you would be set up for life.
But that promise has been found wanting.
As degrees became universal, they became devalued.
Education was no longer a secure route of social mobility.
Today, 28 per cent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles, a percentage which is double the average among OECD countries.
translations: 千禧一代曾被告知，如果你在学校表现良好，获得一个像样的学位，你就能为生活打下基础。
但这一承诺已被发现有所欠缺。
随着学位的普及，它们变得贬值了。
教育不再是社会流动的可靠途径。
如今，英国有28%的毕业生从事非毕业生岗位，这一比例是经合组织国家平均水平的两倍。

sentences: This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available.
translations: 这并不是说获得学位没有意义，而是强调学位并不适合所有人，从教室到演讲厅的转变并非不可避免，而且还有其他选择。

sentences: Thankfully, there are signs that this is already happening, with Generation Z seeking to learn from their millennial predecessors, even if parents and teachers tend to be still set in the degree mindset.
Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates.
Many too are seeing the advantages of scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles.
translations: 值得庆幸的是，有迹象表明这种情况已经在发生，Z世代试图向他们的千禧一代前辈学习，即使父母和老师往往仍然固守学位观念。
雇主们早已看到雇佣离校生的优势，他们往往证明自己比毕业生更敬业、更忠诚。
许多人也在看到取消某些职位学位要求的优势。

sentences: For those for whom a degree is the desired route, consider that this may well be the first of many.
In this age of generalists, it pays to have specific knowledge or skills.
Postgraduates now earn 40 per cent more than graduates.
When more and more of us have a degree, it makes sense to have two.
translations: 对于那些认为学位是理想途径的人来说，请考虑这很可能只是众多学位中的第一个。
在这个通才时代，拥有特定的知识或技能是值得的。
现在研究生比毕业生多赚40%。
当我们越来越多的人拥有学位时，拥有两个学位是有道理的。

sentences: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21; they will need to be constantly up-skilling throughout their career to stay employable.

It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity, will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers.
Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z’s career trajectory.
translations: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁就完成教育；他们需要在职业生涯中不断提升技能以保持就业能力。
据估计，由于技术的压力、个人成就感的愿望和对多样性的渴望，这一代人将在其工作生涯中为17个不同的雇主工作，并拥有五种不同的职业。
教育，而不仅仅是校园中获得的知识，将成为Z世代职业轨迹的核心部分。

sentences: Older generations often talk about their degree in the present and personal tense; ‘I am a geographer’, or ‘I am a classist’.
Their sons or daughters would never say such a thing; it’s as if they already know that their degree won’t define them in the same way.
translations: 老一辈人经常用现在时和个人时态谈论他们的学位；‘我是一名地理学家’，或‘我是一名古典主义者’。
他们的儿子或女儿绝不会说这样的话；就好像他们已经知道他们的学位不会以同样的方式定义他们。

sentences:
26. The author suggests that Generation Z should
A. be careful in choosing a college
B. be diligent at each educational stage
C. reassess the necessity of college education
D. postpone their undergraduate application
translations:
26. 作者建议Z世代应该
A. 谨慎选择大学
B. 在每个教育阶段都勤奋
C. 重新评估大学教育的必要性
D. 推迟他们的本科申请

sentences:
27. The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects
A. Millennials’ opinions about work
B. the shrinking value of a degree
C. public discontent with education
D. the desired route of social mobility
translations:
27. 英国毕业生从事非毕业生岗位的比例反映了
A. 千禧一代对工作的看法
B. 学位价值的缩水
C. 公众对教育的不满
D. 理想的社会流动途径

sentences:
28. The author considers it a good sign that
A. Generation Z are seeking to earn a decent degree
B. school leavers are willing to be skilled workers
C. employers are taking a realistic attitude to degrees
D. parents are changing their minds about education
translations:
28. 作者认为这是一个好迹象，因为
A. Z世代正在寻求获得一个像样的学位
B. 离校生愿意成为技术工人
C. 雇主对学位采取现实态度
D. 父母正在改变他们对教育的看法

sentences:
29. It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should
A. make an early decision on their career
B. attend on-the-job training programs
C. team up with high-paid postgraduates
D. further their studies in a specific field
translations:
29. 第五段建议那些拥有一个学位的人应该
A. 尽早对自己的职业做出决定
B. 参加在职培训项目
C. 与高薪研究生合作
D. 在特定领域深造

sentences:
30. What can be concluded about Generation Z from the last two paragraphs?
A. Lifelong learning will define them.
B. They will make qualified educators.
C. Degrees will no longer appeal to them.
D. They will have a limited choice of jobs.
translations:
30. 从最后两段可以得出关于Z世代的什么结论？
A. 终身学习将定义他们。
B. 他们将成为合格的教育者。
C. 学位将不再吸引他们。
D. 他们的工作选择将有限。
